--- NOTE: A Lighthouse Is a Promise.md ---
# A Lighthouse Is a Promise[^1]

A lighthouse is a promise made to ships.
It burns whether or not a ship is near.

[^1]: [[@A History of Lighthouses - Rhea Vale]]

--- NOTE: The Keeper Kept the Promise.md ---
# The Keeper Kept the Promise[^1]

The keeper kept that promise for the harbour.

[^1]: [[@A History of Lighthouses - Rhea Vale]]
